Discover the heartwarming tale of Eve in *The Charming Kitten: A Stray in the Heart of Night*. ## Synopsis & Story Highlights

Eve was looking forward to her family vacation, but the plan changes when she finds herself volunteering at a friend's cat shelter. While working there, Eve meets himâa kitten with beautiful, sandy fur that captures her heart immediately. As they spend time together, their bond deepens, and Eve soon realizes this little stray is more than just cute; he holds a special secret.

Whether your child loves animal stories or mysteries, *The Charming Kitten* is a must-read addition to any collection of beloved children's literature.
